content.rendered: On February 13 Sherwood School District will host a neighborhood meeting for community members living near the new high school site, in the cafeteria of Laurel Ridge Middle School from 6:00-7:00 p.m.  The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the land use approval process for the new high school project, including the request for a Conditional Use Permit.
